messages.author: 299a5089d6c6c523
messages.subject: Re: The application failed to start (exited with code 1).
parts:
Actually, that looks like your application was deployed, but it is crashing immediately when it starts.
You might see more information in rsconnect::showLogs, but either gapminder wasn't declared or wasn't able to be loaded.
Does the application run locally?
